{{recipe}}

This is a recipe for a corn and kelp chowder.

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Maize|corn]] kernels (removed from the cob)
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] dried [[Cookbook:Kelp|sea kelp]] (or [[Cookbook:Laver|laver]])
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]] or [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 1 green or red [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
#Melt butter in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|pan]], add the kelp, and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until it begins to dissolve in the butter. 
#Add the remaining ingredients, turn down to low heat, and cover.
#[[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 30–40 minutes until soft. 
#Remove cover and cook on low heat until water most of the liquid is evaporated.
